15. ORDINANCE -3"™ READING — Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from LI Light Industrial and MR Medium-
Density Residential to MR Medium-Density Residential for land located on Lots 14 and
15, Christensen Park.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

16. ORDINANCE -3" READING — Amending Section 2.4.2 Annexations of the Unified
Development Code, and creating Section 2.2.8, Assigned Zoning, clarifying City zone
assignment processes in concert with annexations and when removing City zone districts.

Dr. Aldrich moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried
with Dr. Aldrich and Dr. Rinne voting “YES” and Mr. Laybourn voting “NO”.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

17, ORDINANCE -3" READING ~ Amending Section 2.2.1.c.5 and 2.2.2.c.6 of the Unified
Development Code (UDC), amending protest petitions for zoning map amendments and
planned developments.

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 3" and final reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Dr. Rinne moved
to strike 20% of property owners and replace it with 50% of property owners throughout the
proposed sections, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion to amend failed with Dr. Aldrich and Mr.
Laybourn voting “NO” and Dr. Rinne voting “YES”. Main motion failed with Dr. Aldrich and
Mr. Laybourn voting "NO” and Dr. Rinne voting “YES”.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and committee
members Aldrich and Rinne commented on the item. Public comment was made by Michael
White.

18. ORDINANCE -2™ READING — Creating Chapter 8.68, Camping in Public Places, of Title
8, Health and Safety, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming,
Prohibiting the Act of Camping on Public Property as Specified. (SPONSORS ~ MR.
LAYBOURN AND MR. WHITE)

Dr. Rinne excused himself from the meeting during discussion on item #18, at 1:02 p.m. due toa
previously scheduled work commitment.

Mr, Laybourn moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Dr. Aldrich moved
amend section 8.68.040(B) by striking the sentence “When abating any campsite under this
section, the department shall remove all personal property to a designated storage location and
shall not dispose of or otherwise destroy any personal property until after the expiration of
sixty(60) days from the date the property was removed from the campsite” and in section 8.68.040
